name: Rock Solid Backpackers Rotorua NZ
description:
Welcome to Rock Solid Backpackers! We're all about helping you explore Rotorua at its best - and making some awesome friends along the way!

Based on Hinemoa Street in the heart of Rotorua's CBD, we offer a cozy home-from-home for travelers and backpackers looking to explore, make friends and have a great night's sleep at the end of the day. Our staff are previous and existing backpackers and we love to help you have a great stay, whatever you're wanting to do! 

Right in the heart of Rotorua
- We're right in the center of Rotorua with access to shops, restaurants and cafes all around us. We're a few minutes walk from some of Rotorua's best attractions, including Polynesian Spa, Te Pa Tu Maori Village, Government Gardens, the Rotorua Lakefront and Kuirau Park. On Thursdays, the Rotorua Night Market is right outside our front doors. 

Climbing Wall
- We're the only hostel (that we know off!) with a climbing wall a few steps away from your room. Experience New Zealand's tallest wall and enjoy a major discount when you stay with us.  

Cozy and Comfortable Rooms
- Whether its meeting other travelers in the dorms or spreading out with a private room, we have a range of room types to suit your needs and budget. All rooms have two pillows as standard and warm, comfy beds, helping you to get a great sleep after a day of adventures. 

Vibrant Atmosphere and Activities
- We run in-house activities throughout the week including the quiz, karaoke, scavenger hunts and movie nights, giving you more opportunities to meet other travelers and to win awesome prizes for local activities! Check out our Linkups and our Reception board for what's happening during your stay!

Welcoming Staff
- Our staff care about you having the best stay with us. A lot of us were backpackers in the past (or present) and are on hand to help with anything you need during your stay. Come see us and say Kia Ora!

Help booking your Activities
- We can book any activity in Rotorua, from hot springs and Maori village tours to whitewater rafting and more. If you're ever stuck with what to do, come see us at Reception for activities to suit your stay and budget. If you need a shuttle or a pickup, we can help you out!

Sustainable Champions
- We want to make as little impact on our environment as we can, and help you do the same! We recycle cardboard, paper, plastic, metal, soft plastics, glass, batteries, polystyrene and more. Our cleaning products and hostel supplies are sourced from sustainable suppliers, meaning they don't harm our environment!

Mates Rates
- We offer cheeky discounts on dozens of activities across Rotorua - come and see us to see what we can save you money on!

Hostel Facilities:

- Qualmark Silver Accredited
- Shampoo, Conditioner and Bodywash in all showers
- Two Pillows on all beds
- Tea and Coffee Facilities across the hostel
- Wheelchair Friendly Ramps
- Late Check-in service for arrivals outside of Reception Hours
- Long Term and Weekly rates
- Free travel sims
- Laundry and Drying Facilities, including drying racks
- 24/hour kitchen and lounge facilities
- 24/hour staff presence for night-time problems. 
- Check-ins from 2pm, earlier if possible!
- Check-outs from 10am

Come and say kia ora at Rotorua's most unique backpacker's hostel! :)

houseRules.notes:
We require a valid passport photo ID and credit card at the time of check-in.

Quiet Time : 10pm - 7am. We respectfully ask guests to minimise noise during this time to help our travellers get a great night's sleep. Any disturbances overnight can be reported by calling our after-hours team using the number of the back of your room's door. 

Alcohol is permitted to be consumed at the hostel. During our quiet time, we ask that alcohol not be consumed or to head off-site to continue. 

Late check-ins must be pre-arranged, please email us on bookings@rocksolidrotorua.co.nz for instructions.

Children of all ages welcome if accompanied by adults, each child needs it's own bed and the whole room needs to be booked for private use. We accept 16/17 year olds to stay with us unaccompanied provided they have parental consent.
